classification.rationale: A women's knee-length coat is an overcoat or carcoat-type garment of heading 6202 (assuming woven fabric). Polyester predominates by weight, so it falls under 6202.40 of man-made fibers, and 30% wool is below the 36% wool threshold of 6202.40.15, leaving 6202.40.20.
